name: ask-ledger
description: Catches the silent avert — work that quietly does less than the ask named, with no reason written anywhere. On the first work-shaped prompt a hook destructures the ask into its named things (proper nouns, quoted terms, 2D/3D-style tokens) and keeps them as a session ledger; a Stop gate refuses a final message that does not account for each one — `<name>: as named | substituted → what, why | omitted → why`. The script proves the accounting exists; whether it is true is the model's word and the reader's eye. Off with CC_ASK_LEDGER=off.

cc_ask_ledger.title: Ask ledger and its Stop gate (CC_ASK_LEDGER)
cc_ask_ledger.description: Ledger what a prompt names and have the Stop gate ask for an accounting line for each: on or off. The environment variable CC_ASK_LEDGER overrides this.
